title: Trespassing Takahashi
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 7 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq K \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; N-1 \leq M \leq \min (2 \times 10^5, \frac{N(N-1)}{2}); 1 \leq a_i \lt b_i \leq N; If i \neq j, then (a_i,b_i) \neq (a_j,b_j).; 1 \leq c_i \leq 10^9; One can travel from any point to any other point using some number of roads.; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq x_i \lt y_i \leq K; 1 \leq t_1 \leq \ldots \leq t_Q \leq 10^{15}; All values in input are integers.
